first_public_date_evidence: A dated public US Government Printing Office Monthly Catalog issue on 1925-04-01 lists Bulletin 146. The original Bulletin is marked February 1925 without a verified issue day; April 1 is a conservative verified day-specific public record and not its asserted release date.
integrity: Proof and formulas are self-contained; CHECK.py is an independently executable numerical cross-check, not a certificate of the infinite-parameter statements.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the constant-rate zero-initial-deficit Streeter–Phelps model and a single fixed multiplicative oxygen-deficit reduction. Other water-quality processes, multiple devices and cost-efficiency variations are excluded. A plausibly relevant 1975 Koivo–Phillips source is not fully accessible, so equivalent coverage remains possible.
title: Finite-reach saturation and a quadratic placement law for one fractional river aerator
